resources.string: BMW handles calls. Android Auto stays connected.
Only this explicitly selected device may be overridden again during the 4-second startup window. Leave unset for a single initial attempt.
Requires MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS authorization through ADB. No root, accessibility, default-dialer replacement, or always-on foreground service is used.

First leave automation off. While parked, make a normal call, leave it on the bad route, and press Route now. This performs one request and bypasses only the Android Auto detection gate. Emergency and device-identity checks still apply.

No internet, audio recording, contacts, or call-log access. Exported app logs exclude phone numbers and use salted device aliases. Unknown/emergency calls and multiple-call sessions are left to Android.
